blocks.content: We are given an Employees table with the columns emp_id, name, department, and salary.
The problem statement requires us to check the condition on two fronts:

items: the employee must belong to the Sales department
the employee must have a salary greater than 50000

blocks.content: After the selection, we need to order our results alphabetically. We can do this with the ORDER BY clause and the ASC command.
